# Volvo Ebal — Volvo Automates

> I build the system that runs the business after the lead comes in:
> GoHighLevel for the follow-up, n8n for the wiring between tools, and custom
> applications built with Claude Code when nothing on the market fits.

Independent automation specialist. Based in the Philippines, working with
businesses in the United States and elsewhere, remotely. Six client
engagements since 2023. Every figure below was stated by the client, not
estimated.

## What I am hired for

- **GoHighLevel.** CRM builds and repairs: pipelines, segmentation,
  reactivation campaigns, and AI voice or chat agents wired into the CRM so an
  inquiry arriving at 9pm is answered at 9pm.
- **n8n and workflow automation.** Records move between the CRM, the sheets,
  the inbox and the ad platforms without anyone retyping them. Broken
  workflows get found and repaired.
- **Custom applications, built with Claude Code.** Eleven shipped to date,
  three of them live on the public internet.

## Engagements and their stated results

- Omni Power Solar — inbound voice agent builder, Nov 2025 to Feb 2026.
  40% more leads captured in the first month.
- Leadworx.io — n8n workflow developer, Nov 2025 to Jan 2026.
  12 hours a week returned, three campaigns self-running.
- Your AI Army — automation lead, Oct 2025.
  8 workflows repaired, error rate down 70%.
- Corlan Electric LLC — back-end tech support and CRM management,
  Mar 2025 to Aug 2025. Quoting under 10 minutes, 20% less processing time.
- Heartaccent LLC — Pinterest moderation and automations,
  Nov 2024 to Mar 2025. 20 posts a week automated, 8 hours a week saved.
- Godzilla Digital LLC — junior developer and CRM specialist,
  Nov 2023 to May 2024. Five platforms unified.

## Applications, live and openable

- Database Reactivation — https://database-reactivation.pages.dev
  An AI SMS agent that texts a CRM's dead leads, qualifies replies, books calls.
- Colorly — https://colorly.pages.dev
  An offline paint-by-number game with fifteen generators.
- SnapVault — https://snapvault-rho.vercel.app
  Backs up an iPhone's photos and video so the storage can be cleared.

Also built and running locally: Phone Bridge, a local video editor, a video QA
reviewer, an MLS prospecting agent, Pomodoro Cat, a video downloader, and
AdbundanceOS, a voice-driven operations dashboard.

## Tools shipped with

n8n, Make.com, Zapier, Apify, RapidAPI, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Apollo, Sales
Navigator, Intercom, Claude Code, Claude, Retell AI, Gemini, Grok, Node,
Next.js, Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, Supabase, OpenPhone, Slack, Monday.com,
Dropbox.

## How an engagement runs

1. Week 0, find the bottleneck. Twenty minutes on a call. He says so when a
   process is not worth automating.
2. Week 1, one process wired end to end inside the client's own tools.
3. Then handover with a runbook. If it breaks it tells somebody, because a
   silent failure is worse than no automation.
